name: White River — Bull Shoals Boat Ramp to Guion Boat Ramp-Izard County
blurb: The White River below Bull Shoals Dam: a cold, dam-controlled trout tailwater between AGFC ramps. Levels change with generation.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Bull Shoals Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Gaston's Resort Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Cold tailwater below a U.S. AGFC Bull Shoals tailwater map: call 870-431-5311 (Corps of Engineers) for current generation conditions below Bull Shoals Dam. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
